stories.title: Show HN: An offline desktop companion to help maintain a healthy blink rhythm
summary: I am already a victim of it, working 20 years as a research engineer in computer vision, zooming into pixel level details to hand craft algorithms.

Now the doctors says its only regular use of lubricating drops can keep your eyes safe.Now with AI and available fantastic libraries it's possible to play safe so that your body does not pay the price of your profession.

It is also capable to automatically track the face using multiple webcams that you might have on your working desk to get the best view of your eyes for accurate blink detection.Most importantly it works completely local no internet required.

stories.title: Israeli president picks Netanyahu's rival Gadi Eisenkot to try to form government
summary: Israel’s president on Saturday chose Gadi Eisenkot, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s strongest rival, to try to form a new government following a deadlocked election that left neither man with a clear path to power.
Eisenkot and Netanyahu have both ​said they would not form a government with parties primarily representing Israeli citizens of Palestinian descent, who comprise around a fifth of the population.
Both Eisenkot and Netanyahu say Israeli troops will not withdraw from Gaza until Hamas ​is disarmed, and that Israel is prepared to ​restart fighting to achieve this.

stories.title: Lando Norris claims F1 São Paulo GP pole as ‘crazy’ rain disrupts qualifying
summary: McLaren driver fastest ahead of Mercedes duoAntonelli to start on front row alongside NorrisMastering the most treacherous of conditions at Interlagos, Lando Norris had the edge to take pole position for McLaren at the São Paulo Grand Prix, having bested a downpour that tested every driver.

But with more rain predicted for the race on Sunday, it remains wide open from the front to the very back of the grid.After a qualifying session that took two and a half hours to complete because of delays caused by the heavy rain, Norris came out on top but the grid will be marked by a very mixed-up formation, as a host of drivers took penalties.
